name: Claude Code Usage
description: Aggregate Claude Code (CLI) usage computed locally: lifetime session and message totals, per-model token consumption and cost, day-by-day activity, hour-of-day distribution, and the longest recorded session.

profile.description: Identifying account context for the Claude Code installation (read locally; never includes credentials).

totals.description: Lifetime totals across all Claude Code usage.

sessions.description: Total number of Claude Code sessions recorded.

messages.description: Total number of messages exchanged across all sessions.

firstSessionDate.description: Timestamp of the first recorded session (ISO 8601).

lastComputedDate.description: Date these stats were last recomputed (YYYY-MM-DD).

speculationTimeSavedMs.description: Total milliseconds saved by speculative decoding.

inputTokens.description: Non-cached input tokens sent to this model.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens generated by this model.

cacheReadInputTokens.description: Input tokens served from the prompt cache.

cacheCreationInputTokens.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

webSearchRequests.description: Number of web-search tool requests attributed to this model.

costUSD.description: Estimated cost in USD for this model (may be 0 if not tracked).

contextWindow.description: Context window size in tokens, if known.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens for this model, if known.

dailyModelTokens.description: Per-day token usage broken down by model.

tokensByModel.description: Map of model id to total tokens used that day.

hourCounts.description: Map of hour-of-day (0-23, local time) to number of messages, showing when you use Claude Code.

longestSession.description: The single longest session by wall-clock duration.

totalCostUSD.description: Sum of per-model estimated cost in USD.

profile.description: Identifying account context for the Claude Code installation (read locally; never includes credentials).

numStartups.description: Number of times Claude Code has been launched on this machine.

firstStartTime.description: First launch timestamp on this machine (ISO 8601).
